From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Mike Dunn <mike.dunn@helios-ops.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-18T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Purchase order + KYC pack for Redwood Dedicated (PO#1028)

Hi Mike — really appreciate the fast turnaround and the PO. Quick note: our onboarding pipeline flagged one of the beneficial owners in your packet during sanctions screening (automated alert). That's a standard eligibility hold — I can't finalize provisioning until our compliance team signs off.

I've looped in Laura (Head of Revenue Ops) for a quick decision and to confirm whether we should pause provisioning or proceed with limited access pending manual review. Procurement timelines are understood; we'll expedite the compliance review but need formal guidance on whether to accept mitigations (e.g., restricted feature set, escrowed logs) or to hold the order.

I'll keep you updated. If you can also provide any corporate registry or beneficiary declaration that's not redacted, that speeds things up.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
Attachments: (screening output: sanctions-screening.csv)

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com; marissa_cole@redwood.com; ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-19T08:41:00-07:00
Subject: Escalation: Helios Ops — AML/KYC flag on beneficial owner (deal DL-2026-0897)

Laura / Marissa / Ben —

Quick summary: Helios Ops (PO#1028) is ready to commit to Redwood Dedicated, ~8 GPU nodes, monthly commit. External docs attached. Automated sanctions check flagged a 12% beneficial owner as matching a watchlist variant (name similarity + DOB close). The customer disputes the match and has provided a scanned beneficiary list (helios_beneficial_owners.pdf). Procurement needs provisioning date week of Nov 8.

Questions for deal desk / execs:
- Approve expedited manual remediation and limited provisioning under elevated monitoring?
- Require full legal signoff and hold billing until clearance?
- Deny / reject if the ownership link is confirmed?

Risk notes:
- If the match is a false positive, delay will cost ~ $16k MRR and push their go-live.
- If it's a true match, we have regulatory exposure (sanctions risk) and contractual complications for Dedicated.

Proposed mitigations (if allowed to proceed):
- Start with read-only access + disabled model exporting features; increased audit retention and real-time alerting for calls to restricted APIs.
- Require notarized beneficial ownership attestation and corporate registry within 72 hours.
- Escrowed logs accessible to Redwood legal while review completes.

I am requesting an executive decision: expedited exception with constraints OR pause and route to legal for refusal. Need direction by EOD 10/20 to meet procurement timing.

Thanks,
Jonas

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com; marissa_cole@redwood.com; ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-19T11:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Escalation: Helios Ops — AML/KYC flag on beneficial owner (deal DL-2026-0897)

Jonas —

Thanks for the clear summary. My guidance:

1) No unconditional provisioning while any beneficial owner is positively flagged against sanctions/watchlists.
2) We can consider a limited, timeboxed pilot with strict controls if the customer provides notarized registry documents and a signed indemnity that puts the onus on the customer for accuracy of ownership information. Legal intake required (please loop in legal@redwood.com).
3) If they cannot provide verifiable docs within 72 hours, put the deal on hold and pause billing.

Ben — please prepare a brief with the projected revenue impact and list the specific product capabilities to be restricted (suggest: export API, model snapshots, log exports). Marissa — please confirm whether this merits a credit/discount consideration if we delay; if so, outline the approval threshold.

Jonas — communicate the package below to the customer and ask for notarized ownership evidence + legal contact. If customer pushes for a start date without documents, escalate to me and Marissa immediately.

Laura Bennett
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Mike Dunn <mike.dunn@helios-ops.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com; procurements@helios-ops.com; legal@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-20T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Purchase order + KYC pack for Redwood Dedicated (PO#1028) — eligibility hold and next steps

Mike —

Quick update from our side: our compliance team has placed an eligibility hold after automated screening flagged a minor beneficial owner. To proceed we require the following within 72 hours:

1) Notarized corporate registry showing beneficial ownership breakdown (scanned + original available on request).
2) A signed indemnity agreeing to assume liability if the ownership information proves incorrect.
3) Point of contact for Helios legal to coordinate with Redwood legal (legal@helios-ops.com).

If you can provide these, we can discuss a limited pilot (read-only access, disabled export/model snapshot capabilities, increased audit retention) while legal completes verification. Otherwise, we will need to place provisioning and billing on hold.

Attachments included: sanctions-screening.csv (automated match), request_template_indemnity.docx (template), list_of_restricted_features.txt

Please advise on timing — procurement indicated they want Nov 8 start; we will escalate internally to try to meet that but need the docs ASAP.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
